author: CNET
description:
Ring Home Security has taken flight. ✈️🚨

The $250 mini indoor drone camera weights 5.8 ounces and houses a pair of 2K cameras mounted on the front and bottom. It uses a learned map of your home to zoom around autonomously for up to 8 minutes at a time with custom routes to record places a couple of fixed cameras can’t.

CNET managing editor David Watsky is here to give you a first look at the Ring Drone Cam, coming in 2027. #homesecurity #amazonring #ringdronecam #firstlook #securitydrone

Note: The unit demoed is a ‘pre-production model’ and the finals will ship in a dark grey color.
